source_text: Qui benedicunt eum hereditabunt terram; qui maledicunt exterminabuntur. Gloria Christo. Amen.
thought_title: Blessing and cursing decide inheritance of the land
orientation: Origen is closing the first homily on Psalm 36 with a final psalm verse and a doxology to Christ.
pass_a_gloss: Those who bless him will inherit the land; those who curse him will be destroyed. Glory to Christ. Amen.

choices.why: The glossary requires 'land' for terra, and the future tense of the verb is preserved.
The passive future of extermino here means to be driven out or destroyed, matching the psalm's contrast with inheriting.
A standard doxological formula; the dative Christo is rendered with 'to' to show the recipient of glory.

bible_refs.note: Qui benedicunt eum hereditabunt terram; qui maledicunt exterminabuntur

pass_b_english: Those who bless him will inherit the land; those who curse him will be destroyed (Psalm 37:22, LXX 36:22). Glory to Christ. Amen.

last_rejected.source_quote: Qui benedicunt eum hereditabunt terram; qui maledicunt exterminabuntur
last_rejected.why: Verse 22 is wrong; this is Psalm 37:9 (LXX 36:9) or possibly conflated with 37:22, but matches neither exactly.
last_rejected.ruling: Psalm 37:22 LXX 36:22 reads 'Qui benedicunt eum hereditabunt terram; qui maledicunt exterminabuntur' matching source exactly.
